description: The figure is a horizontal bar chart illustrating how many participants (N=6) highlighted each evaluation criterion as beneficial. The category axis is vertical and labeled “Criterion,” listing (from top to bottom) Relevant FCs, FC Summary, Relevance Explanation, Clarity and Simplicity, Overall Summary, Filters, and Veracity Explanation. The value axis is horizontal and labeled “Number of Participants,” shown on a linear scale from 0 to 6 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0, 2, 4, and 6. Each criterion is represented by a single solid-colored horizontal bar with a numeric value annotation at the bar end: Relevant FCs is a dark purple bar reaching 6; FC Summary is a dark blue bar reaching 5; Relevance Explanation is a blue-green/teal bar reaching 3; Clarity and Simplicity is a teal-green bar reaching 3; Overall Summary is a green bar reaching 2; Filters is a light green bar reaching 1; and Veracity Explanation is a yellow-green bar reaching 1. The bars appear ordered from highest to lowest count (descending) from top to bottom, and the only visible emphasis is the value labels placed at the ends of the bars.
